sources.name: Seychelles Agricultural Agency, Veterinary Services - import conditions for cats and dogs (PDF, hosted by anivetvoyage.com)
sources.note: Opened; official agency letterhead: Veterinary Services, Union Vale, Mahe, phone +248 4285 950, seyvet@seychelles.net, only quarantine station on Mahe. Regulatory/import office, not a pet clinic (pet care was handed to the private sector in 2019), so not an entry.

sources.name: SBC - Veterinary services for pets in Seychelles handed over to private sector (2019)
sources.note: Opened; Paw Links Veterinary Care started pet care 20 May 2019 at the Union Vale Veterinary Clinic near Victoria. No phone or hours on the page (the phone shown is SBC's).

sources.name: Paw Links Veterinary Care (Paw Links Supplies) own listing page on koek.sc
sources.note: Opened; Anse Boileau, Mahe, phone +248 2818971; no hours, no 24 h wording. The /en version was blocked by provenance, not opened.

sources.name: Inside Seychelles - Stray Animals in Seychelles (2023 blog)
sources.note: Opened; lists emergency vet contacts on Mahe (Medi Vet Clinic and individual vets) and says Praslin and La Digue have no real vet. Tourist blog only, so used as a lead, no entries taken from it.

entries.name: Paw Links Veterinary Care
entries.duty: Small-animal care on Mahe. Call ahead for opening hours and emergencies.
entries.note: Listing page says Anse Boileau, no street address, no hours, no 24 h claim. SBC 2019 article says Paw Links runs the Union Vale Veterinary Clinic near Victoria (no phone/hours found), so the service may operate from Union Vale; confirm.

duty_i18n.it: Cura dei piccoli animali a Mahe. Telefonare in anticipo per orari di apertura ed emergenze.

notes: Research 2026-11-12, all source_urls opened with WebFetch. Seychelles has very few vets. No animal poison line and no duty rota found (no Seychelles veterinary association site found; Agency for Agriculture has no public clinic list). Not added for lack of a first-hand business page: Medi Vet Clinic (Mahe, +248 260 4291 / 271 0088, only from the Inside Seychelles blog, 2023), Union Vale Veterinary Clinic (no phone or site), named individual vets (private persons, skipped). Praslin and La Digue: blog says no real vet; SAWS held a temporary 8-day La Digue clinic in 2018 (SBC) and sterilisation camps, no permanent clinic found. Seychelles Agricultural Agency Veterinary Services (Union Vale, +248 4285 950) is the import/quarantine authority, not published as a clinic.
